JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey

answer: SAUDI ARABIA made the most profit in 1998 from parts whose name contains 'green', with total profit of about 279,378,137.20. (Profit = sum of extendedprice*(1-discount) minus ps_supplycost*quantity, joined on partkey and suppkey, grouped by the supplier's nation, year from order date.)

sql:
SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS profit
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1998-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1999-01-01'
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY profit DESC
LIMIT 5
